notes.title: Updated notes on October 26, 2024 2024年10月26日更新说明
notes.content:
This update includes:
1. Adjust the game launch resolution. Originally, when the resolution of the computer screen of some players is high, the game screen cannot be displayed normally. This is fixed.
2. Adjust some of the conversations.
3. Adjust some processes.
本次更新包括：
1. 调整游戏启动分辨率。原本部分玩家电脑屏幕分辨率配置较高时，游戏画面无法正常显示。现已修复。
2. 调整部分对话。
3. 调整部分流程。

notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
This update mainly includes:
1. Updated resolution adaptation. Originally, when the computer screen configuration of some players was high, the interface could not be displayed normally. This has been corrected.
2. Updated some conversations.
3. Adjustments were made to processes.

本次更新主要包括：
1. 对分辨率适配进行了更新。原本部分玩家电脑屏幕配置较高时，界面无法正常显示。本次已进行修正。
2. 对部分对话进行了更新。
3. 对个别流程进行了调整。
